key_insight: The paper introduces a validated LBM-based dataset pipeline for benchmarking neural operators on 3D turbulent obstructed channel flows.
engineering_relevance: It provides a reproducible, physics-checked foundation for comparing CFD surrogates on forecasting, super-resolution, and error-correction tasks.
method: Generate 3D channel-flow cases with random/constructed obstacles at Re=1,000–10,000.
Use a lattice Boltzmann solver with cumulant collision operators and perform grid-convergence verification.
Benchmark surrogates with physics-informed metrics on turbulence and flow observables.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports validation against experiments using Strouhal number, drag coefficients, and turbulent fluctuations, plus grid convergence at 1024×512×512 resolution.
watch_item: Surrogate results may be sensitive to dataset generalization and metric choice, especially when assessing whether models capture the turbulent energy cascade.
paper_title: A Validated LBM Dataset and Pipeline for Surrogate Modeling of Turbulent 3D Obstructed Channel Flows
